info.description: Loopback-only API. Exchange the private single-use launch URL for an HttpOnly session cookie, then read /api/v1/runtime for the session CSRF token. Every mutation and transfer requires the X-CSRF-Token header. Secret reveal additionally requires credential-specific reauthentication.
